scenario_predefinition.pad_midpoint_hypothesis: 30mm comes from actual 60mm pad geometry; shows frame semantic distinction without recommending simultaneous changes

inferences: Existing p-to-tip identity does not establish effective-face physical placement.
Observed upper-cap first contacts can produce downward normal components; predicted static normals are not actual dynamic contact forces.
A favourable geometric outcome under any counterfactual is insufficient to justify editing the candidate, depth, or TCP. Use source semantics and independently reviewed one-variable correction.
unverifiable_in_this_task: No hypothetical scenario has engine contact or grasp outcome evidence.
No actual IP140 settled poses exist for unrun slots8/9. Initial pose heights must not be called settled heights.
Triangle/box calculations omit collision margin smoothing, engine convexification details, compliance and loaded drift. Mesh convexity diagnostic is provided, not a backend equivalence proof.
Compound voxel box sections are convex envelopes and may bridge gaps; normals are ideal flat asset-face normals.
No entire-UR5e motion-table clearance validation of alternative transforms; listed clearance covers IP140 component boxes at static goal only.

old_tool_comparison.definition: old rq_robotiq_140_base_link origin required by old downward collision envelope, not IP140 tip or pad coordinate
old_tool_comparison.IP140: F_T_G yields static flange origin = G origin - R_W_G*[.070,0,0]; for these downward grasps flange z=tip z+.070
old_tool_comparison.no_transfer: do not apply old gripper-base lower-bound numerically to IP140 G or flange; geometries and named frame differ
